annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Compositor-agnostic bridge protocol: the registration handshake, and modifier and gesture reporting. The bus name that registers is the identity every compositor-only method on the daemon admits, not only the reports here. Window manipulation commands flow over org.plasmazones.WindowTracking (applyGeometryRequested, applyGeometriesBatch, ...).

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Register a compositor bridge. Returns session info. Only the compositor's own process may register (the process serving the daemon's Wayland connection, or kwin_wayland as the direct child of kwin_wayland_wrapper), and only one bridge at a time, so while a registered bridge is still on the bus another connection's registration is refused. The bus name that registered is the one every compositor-only method on the daemon admits.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Protocol API version as a decimal integer string (PhosphorProtocol::Service::ApiVersion) — NOT the compositor's release version. Peers below the daemon's minimum are rejected.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Supported capabilities: borderless, animation, borders, modifiers, gestures.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Struct: (apiVersion, bridgeName, sessionId). sessionId == 'REJECTED' signals a rejected registration, which callers MUST check before sending stateful calls. It answers an empty compositorName, a protocol version below the minimum, a caller that is not the compositor's process, and a registration while another bridge is still on the bus.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Report keyboard modifier and mouse button state from compositor. Reserved forward surface for bridges without a drag channel, since the KWin bridge reports modifiers through the drag pipeline instead (EXPERIMENTAL interface). Only the registered compositor bridge may call it, and any other caller is answered with AccessDenied.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Report a completed touchpad gesture the compositor recognised on the shell's behalf. The daemon re-emits it as gestureReported for the shell, which maps it to a surface (three-finger swipe up opens the launcher, four-finger swipe up the dashboard, and so on). Only fires for gestures the bridge registered under the 'gestures' capability, and progress is not reported. Only the registered compositor bridge may call it, and any other caller is answered with AccessDenied.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: Finger count of the recognised gesture. The bundled KWin bridge sends 3 or 4; the daemon accepts 1 to 5 and drops anything outside that.

annotation.name: org.gtk.GDBus.DocString
annotation.value: A touchpad gesture the compositor reported through reportGesture, verbatim. The shell subscribes to this.
